basics.name: Dan Nguyen Tien
basics.label: QA Engineer (AI-Augmented) · Aspiring Automotive Embedded Tester
basics.summary: QA Engineer with 2+ years testing microservice-based systems. Strong in requirements-based testing: requirement review, deriving test specifications from approved requirements, equivalence class partitioning, boundary value analysis, execution, results analysis and test reporting. Transitioning into automotive embedded testing (MiL/SiL/HiL) via a structured self-study roadmap.

work.name: HOPEE Co., Ltd.
work.summary: Progressed from QA Intern (06/2024) to Probationary (09/2024) to Junior QA Engineer (11/2024).
highlights: Reviewed requirements and user stories; derived test cases from approved requirements with requirement-to-test traceability (500+ test cases).
Designed tests with equivalence class partitioning, boundary value analysis and risk-based prioritisation.
Executed functional, regression, smoke and API tests (Postman, Mockoon) plus database verification (MySQL, PostgreSQL) across 2+ delivered microservice projects.
Analysed test results, reported and tracked 200+ defects in Jira.
Developed test automation with Selenium WebDriver (Page Object Model); expanding into Playwright. Used Git and Jenkins CI.
Introduced a reviewed AI-assisted QA workflow (Claude, GitHub Copilot) for test scaffolding and CI log triage.
